top_signals.title: Anthropic warns investors of AI’s 'existential risk to humanity' in IPO prospectus, reports say
top_signals.summary: Anthropic's IPO filing dedicates 80 pages to the risks of AI, nearly double the 48 pages it spends discussing its business plans, according to Reuters.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
